thresholdEvidence.notes: The two lower Terrapin cards use a conservative 84–770 cfs seasonal context tied to the direct Ellisville gauge. Upper Terrapin and all Autauga cards remain planning-only because official sources say to paddle when flow is good but do not publish a current reach-specific numeric threshold.

endpointAudit.notes: Terrapin endpoints come from Alabama Scenic River Trail and the City of Piedmont; Autauga endpoints come from Outdoor Alabama, Alabama Scenic River Trail and National Recreation Trails. Private downstream Terrapin take-outs are explicitly called out for outfitter confirmation.

qualityControls.camping: classified on every card; campground or nearby-basecamp only where supported
qualityControls.access: water-edge coordinates and carry/private-access caveats recorded
qualityControls.geometry: curated route traces anchored to named access sequence
qualityControls.duplicateReview: distinct forward reaches only; no reverse pairs or same-endpoint padding
